instruction: What is the total cost of my internet bills for this year? The bills are in "~/bills/" directory of my file system.
notes: Read-only task: no database changes, only an answer. Username comes from supervisor.show_profile, the file_system password from supervisor.show_account_passwords. 'This year' (2023, current datetime 2023-05-18) is established by phone.get_current_date_and_time (current-year-known), which gates reading bill files. Because numeric fluents are not allowed, the summation is encoded as a running-total chain over discrete amount objects: each show_file of a this-year bill advances (running-total) from amount-0 through total-through-2023-04 via static adds-to facts; the final running total is the answer passed to complete_task. The directory '~/bills/internet' is listed once (show_directory) and the four this-year files (Jan-Apr 2023) are a representative instantiation; the actual file list is discovered at runtime from show_directory and files from other years are ignored. Extra non-API parameters of show-file (?d ?prev ?new) only drive the knowledge/aggregation structure.
